notes: 10846 Route 23A, Hunter, NY 12442. A 501(c)(3) headed by a multiple-license wildlife rehabilitator. Far from the city, but the Mayor's Alliance lists it because it gives advice and referrals by phone when it cannot help directly. Its site moved to this address; the old fffwildlifecenter.com no longer exists. Do not give a wild animal food or water while waiting.
